description: Get recent executions for a scheduled job. Returns execution history (status, start/completion times, exit codes, errors) and current schedule configuration (cron expression, timezone, status, last run). Use to monitor job health, diagnose failures, or check execution history. Returns 404 if the project is not a scheduled job or the feature is disabled.

job.description: The App's scheduled job, by its name (telbase jobs list).

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return. Default 10, max 50.

name: get_job_executions
